description_en: Generates a chat response from a document library. You can ask questions in natural language, and the system retrieves relevant information to provide a summarized answer
description_zh: 文档库会话生成，用自然语言提问，检索文档库相关信息，总结回答
kebab_example: aliyun dianjin run-library-chat-generation --workspace-id llm-xxxx --doc-id-list 1273827636xxx --enable-follow-up false --enable-multi-query false --enable-open-qa false --follow-up-llm qwen-max --library-id 3akzl28vap --llm-type qwen-max --multi-query-llm qwen-max --query '这两天北京气候怎么样' --query-criteria '{"or":[{"boost":0.5,"value":"北京","key":"city","operator":"eq"}],"and":[{"boost":0.5,"value":"北京","key":"city","operator":"eq"}]}' --rerank-type linear --session-id example-string --stream false --sub-query-list 北京最近气温如何？ --text-search-parameter searchAnalyzerType=IkMaxWord limit=10 --topk 1 --vector-search-parameter limit=10 --with-document-reference false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunLibraryChatGeneration

element_fields.description_en:

- lt: Less than.
